meta_description: MJC Decorators Sheffield — interior and exterior painting, wallpapering, and decoration. Local, reliable, fully insured. Free quotes.
hero_subhead: Interior and exterior decoration done right. From feature walls to full house repaints, we transform your space.
services_subhead: From intimate room refreshes to full property transformations, we handle every aspect of interior and exterior decoration.

services.title: Interior Painting & Decorating
services.desc: Professional wall and ceiling painting in any colour or finish. We prepare surfaces properly, use premium paints, and leave your rooms pristine.

services.title: Feature Walls & Accent Painting
services.desc: Create visual impact with carefully executed feature walls, bold accent colours, or contemporary finishes. We advise on colour selection to suit your space.

services.title: Wallpapering
services.desc: Expert wallpaper hanging including pattern matching, removal of old paper, and wall preparation. We work with all wallpaper types and specialist finishes.

services.title: Exterior Painting & Weatherproofing
services.desc: Durable exterior finishes that protect and enhance your home's appearance. We use weather-resistant paints and proper preparation for long-lasting results.

services.title: Woodwork & Trim Finishing
services.desc: Skirting boards, doors, frames, and architectural details painted to a high finish. Undercoat and topcoat applied for durability and a professional look.

services.title: Commercial Decoration
services.desc: We decorate offices, retail units, and rental properties. We work around your schedule and leave sites clean and ready to use.

about_pullquote: We do the job once, properly. No shortcuts, no cover-ups.
about_para_1: MJC Decorators has been transforming homes and businesses across Sheffield for over 12 years. Built on honest advice, attention to detail, and pride in our craft, we've completed over 500 decoration projects — from single-room refreshes to complete property repaints. Every job starts with a thorough site visit and a free, transparent quote.
about_para_2: Our customers return because we finish on time, tidy up properly, and deliver results that last. We listen to what you want, advise when you're unsure, and never upsell. A job well done is our best advertisement — many of our bookings come from past client recommendations.
reviews_heading: What Sheffield Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: We had our kitchen repainted and new wallpaper hung in the dining room. Mark was absolutely professional from start to finish. The prep work was thorough, no mess left behind, and the finish is immaculate. Couldn't ask for better. Will definitely use again.
reviews.author: Jennifer P.

reviews.text: Entire lounge redecorated including new feature wall. Price was fair, work was quick without rushing, and Mark took time to explain what he was doing. The quality speaks for itself. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: David M.

reviews.text: Had Mark decorate our hallway and stairs whilst we had new flooring fitted. He coordinated with the other tradies, kept to schedule, and left everything spotless. Real professional. Already booked him again for the upstairs.
reviews.author: Laura T.
